description: WHEN TO CALL: before call_remote_tool, to find the tool for a task and get only its input schema. Pass query (what you want to do) for the best matches, the first with its schema; server (id or short name) to list that server's tools; server + tool for one tool's schema. Each result says whether it can be called through the gateway.

limit.description: Max results for a query (default 5, max 10).

query.description: What you want to do, in plain language (e.g. 'search the web').

server.description: A server id or short name (e.g. 'exa').

tool.description: With server: the tool whose input schema you want.

name: find_tool
